action_items: Pre-existing out-of-scope backend test failures (unchanged from iteration 5, not caused by this iteration): test_tscheck_mhtcet_predictor.py and test_tscheck_pharmacy_cap_predictor.py call /predictor directly without an unlock cookie (402 by design); test_tscheck_predictor_paywall.py::test_unlock_grants_access_cookie_and_pdf_then_rejects_reused_payment_id now also fails because RAZORPAY_KEY_ID/SECRET are configured in this preview, so a fake payment_id goes to the real Razorpay API and gets a genuine 404 instead of the old no-keys mock-acceptance branch -- expected per this iteration's seed_facts (TEST keys can't see real rzp.io payments); test_tscheck_health_probe_and_no_regression.py uses a stale admin password (per seed_facts, do not touch db.admin_auth); weekly_seo_report_cron/duplicate_enquiry tests error under xdist parallelism (shared-state, unrelated).

checks.criterion: Razorpay payment matching (find_by_phone) is robust to how Razorpay Payment Pages record payments
checks.name: test_tscheck_razorpay_find_by_phone.py
checks.evidence: 7 unit tests, httpx.AsyncClient.get mocked (no real Razorpay calls): notes-only phone + amount 153000 for fee 150000 matched (200); amount=fee*2 -> PaymentError 404; amount=fee-1 -> 404; used-payment -> PaymentError 409 'already used'; status=failed -> 402; non-matching contact -> 404; pagination test asserts calls==[0,100] (stopped after a <100-item page, skip=200 never requested).

checks.name: test_tscheck_predictor_unlock_mocked_razorpay.py
checks.evidence: httpx.ASGITransport against server.app, lib.razorpay.find_by_phone monkeypatched (AsyncMock) to return pay_TESTAGENT0002/contact +919876543210/email delivered@resend.dev/amount 59900. POST /predictor/unlock (MHT CET Pharmacy, score 88.5) -> 200 {payment_id, amount:599, masked email/phone, pdf_url}; GET pdf_url with the ds_unlocks cookie -> 200 application/pdf (%PDF header); GET /predictor/access with cookie -> {paid:true}. predictor_unlocks doc deleted in a finally block.

checks.criterion: Live-key behaviour in preview (real Razorpay test keys)
checks.name: test_tscheck_predictor_live_razorpay_404.py
checks.evidence: POST /predictor/unlock for an unpaid mobile (9123456780) against the live running server -> 404, detail starts with 'No new ₹599 payment found'; confirmed backend.out.log contains 'Razorpay find_by_phone: scanned=0 phone_match=0 fee_match_unused=0 ... fee=59900' from this same call.

checks.name: predictor-payment-confirmed-after-mocked-unlock
checks.evidence: On /predictor (MHT CET Pharmacy, 88.5), gate dialog had only name/phone/city/role/college fields (no payment-id/email in the gate); payment dialog (predictor-payment-form) confirmed to have zero payment-id/email input fields. Mocked POST /api/predictor/unlock with a success body (payment_id pay_TESTAGENT_MOCK1, amount 599, masked email/phone, same-origin pdf_url) and mocked that pdf_url to return a real application/pdf attachment -> dialog showed predictor-payment-confirmation with matching id/email/phone text, a Download PDF button, and a real browser download event fired automatically.

checks.name: home-page-loads
checks.evidence: Re-ran existing check against https://digital-shiksha-2.preview.emergentagent.com -> homepage rendered, passed.

notes: Matrix had 4 acceptance criteria; produced 5 artifacts (3 new backend unit/integration test files covering criteria 1-3 which are pure API/library behavior, 1 new browser check covering criterion 4, plus a mandatory re-run of an existing browser check through the public preview URL per instructions).

Criteria 1 and 2 explicitly required in-process mocking (mocking httpx.AsyncClient.get / monkeypatching lib.razorpay.find_by_phone via httpx.ASGITransport against server.app) rather than HTTP-to-running-server black-box testing -- this is a deliberate, matrix-mandated exception to the usual 'never import the app object' convention, since DB-level mocking of an external payment gateway can only work in-process.

Confirmed via code review (PredictorGate.tsx, PredictorPayment.tsx) that neither the lead-capture gate dialog nor the payment dialog have any payment-ID or email input fields -- only a mobile-number field, matching the new phone-based Razorpay matching flow.
Cleaned up fixtures: deleted the predictor_unlocks doc created by the mocked-unlock backend test (finally block) and the 2 'Tscheck Agent' leads created by the new browser check's enquiry submission.

Full backend suite (29 passed) and all pre-existing browser checks remain unaffected by this iteration's additions; the 9 pre-existing failures are documented in action_items as out-of-scope / expected per seed_facts, carried over unchanged from iteration 5.
